overview.location: Windsor Locks, Connecticut — about halfway between Hartford and Springfield, Massachusetts, off I-91 Exit 40. The airport puts the drive at about 15-20 minutes to Hartford and 15 minutes to Springfield. Address: Schoephoester Road, Windsor Locks, CT 06096.
overview.passengerVolume: 6,661,871 passengers in 2025 (about +0.1% year over year, FAA figures via Wikipedia); the airport cites 6.7 million for 2024
overview.distinction: Connecticut's busiest airport and the second-busiest in New England after Boston Logan. Condé Nast Traveler top-ten U.S. airport for seven-plus straight years. One of a handful of U.S. airports with a full-service hotel (Sheraton) attached to the main terminal. Breeze Airways base since 2022.
overview.dominantAirline: No dominant carrier — American (~17.1%), Delta (~16.9%), Southwest (~16.8%), JetBlue (~16.3%) and Breeze (~11.1%) by passenger share, Mar 2025-Feb 2026
overview.totalAirlines: 9 — Aer Lingus, American, Breeze, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Southwest, Sun Country, United
overview.founded: 1941 as Bradley Field, a WWII Army air base named for 2nd Lt. Eugene M. Bradley; commercial flights began 1947
overview.metroAccess: No rail at the terminal. CTtransit 30-Bradley Flyer to downtown Hartford (Union Station, Convention Center) and Route 24 to Windsor Locks rail station (Hartford Line / Amtrak), both from Terminal A Door #6, outer curb.
overview.peopleMover: None — Terminal A is a single building; the Ground Transportation Center is reached by a sheltered walkway (connector by Door #6, level 2).

terminals.name: Terminal A — East Concourse (Gates 1-12)
terminals.notes: Escape Lounge is past security near Gate 1. Aer Lingus Dublin flights pre-clear U.S. Customs in Dublin and arrive at Terminal A.

terminals.name: Terminal A — Gates 18-30 (incl. new 18-20 concourse and West Concourse)
terminals.notes: The airport lists American, Breeze and United in the 20-30 gate section. A nursing room is in the new gates 18-20 concourse.

terminals.name: Terminal B — International Arrivals Building
terminals.status: Active (international arrivals needing U.S. Customs processing only)
terminals.notes: Cancun arrivals and international charters clear CBP here. Airport shuttles connect Terminal B to Terminal A and the parking lots. Park & Walk Lot 2 is across from Terminal B (connecting crosswalk).

roads: Interstate 91 (Exit 40 — main access from every direction)
Schoephoester Road (loops through the airport; Economy Lot 4 and The Parking Spot)
Ella Grasso Turnpike (Route 75) — Days Inn and other off-site lots
Light Lane (Cell Phone Waiting Lot, Lot 5B, new post office access)
transit: CTtransit 30-Bradley Flyer (semi-express to downtown Hartford, ~30 min)
CTtransit Route 24 (to Windsor Locks rail station)
CTrail Hartford Line / Amtrak at Windsor Locks station (~3 miles, via Route 24)
Seemo Shuttle (Five College area, MA) and pre-arranged limousine services

peopleMover.note: Ground Transportation Center (rental cars + 830 public spaces) is a walk from Terminal A via a sheltered walkway.

groundTransportZones.rideshare: Uber and Lyft: 'Ride App Pick-up' sign on the curb outside Door #2, Arrivals/Baggage Claim level. Drivers are staged nearby (3-5 minutes).
groundTransportZones.taxi: Arrivals/Baggage Claim level between exit Doors 2 and 3; an attendant assigns taxis. Schedule or ask about fares: (860) 627-3128.
groundTransportZones.bus: CTtransit 30-Bradley Flyer and Route 24: Terminal A baggage claim/arrivals level, Door #6, outer curb ('Local Buses/CTtransit').
groundTransportZones.hotelShuttles: Triply lot listings say to follow ground transportation signs to the lower-level (arrivals) curb designated for hotel shuttles and call the lot after you collect bags.

routes: 30-Bradley Flyer — semi-express to the Connecticut Convention Center and Union Station, Hartford (~30 min; every 40 min weekdays and Saturdays, about hourly early morning, late night and Sundays)
Route 24 — to Windsor Locks Railroad Station (every 20 min, 4:10 AM-12:30 AM weekdays)
ctTransitBus.accessFromTerminal: Terminal A arrivals level, Door #6, outer curb
ctTransitBus.note: Fares are set by CTtransit — tell readers to check cttransit.com.

rail.station: Windsor Locks station (South Main Street at Stanton Road), ~3 miles from the airport
rail.service: CTrail Hartford Line and Amtrak (New Haven-Hartford-Springfield)
rail.connection: CTtransit Route 24 bus; or Bradley Flyer to Hartford Union Station

taxi.pickup: Between Doors 2 and 3, Arrivals/Baggage Claim level (attendant on site)
taxi.note: Fares not published by the airport — call the number above.

rideshare.pickupLocation: Outside Door #2, Arrivals/Baggage Claim level ('Ride App Pick-up' sign)
rideshare.note: Uber and Lyft are the only authorized ride apps.

rentalCars.location: Ground Transportation Center, 180 Schoephoester Road — walk from Terminal A via the connector by Door #6 (level 2). No shuttle needed. Floor 2: Avis, Budget, Payless. Floor 3: Enterprise, National, Alamo. Floor 4: Hertz, Dollar, Thrifty.
rentalCars.note: No parking for personal vehicles at the rental car pick-up area — park in an airport lot first. Opened 2022 ($210 million, 2,800 rental car spaces).

otherShuttles.seemoShuttle: Seemo Shuttle — Bradley to the Five College area, Western MA: (413) 586-1120
otherShuttles.limousines: Limousines must be pre-arranged; the airport lists authorized providers on its taxi/limo page.

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Triply's three BDL lots are all 1.1-1.3 mi from the terminal in Windsor Locks: Days Inn (Ella Grasso Tpke, 1.1 mi), Econo Lodge Inn & Suites (Old County Rd, 1.2 mi) and Motel 6 (National Drive, 1.3 mi). Call the lot after you collect your bags.

parkingRates: On-airport (official daily rates, taxes included): Economy Lot 4 $7 ($42/week), Economy Lot 3 $8 ($48/week), Park & Walk Lot 2 $10 ($60/week, no shuttle, credit card only), Express Lot 1 $12 ($72/week), Garage $30 ($135/week); Lot 5B overflow $35/week when open. No reservations — arrive and park. Off-site via Triply: three Windsor Locks hotel lots from ~$5.49/day.

economyLot4.name: BDL Economy Lot 4
economyLot4.location: Farther south along Route 75 (23 Schoephoester Rd area)
economyLot4.connection: Free shuttle to Terminal A on a continuous loop, 24/7; trunk-to-trunk service, drivers help with luggage.
economyLot4.features: Cheapest everyday official lot. Lost car locate, tire inflate and battery jump available.

economyLot3.name: BDL Economy Lot 3
economyLot3.rate: $8/day (4-24 hrs); $48/week (6-7 days); $5 first hour, $6 1-2 hrs, $7 2-3 hrs
economyLot3.connection: Free shuttle to Terminal A on a continuous loop, 24/7; trunk-to-trunk service.
economyLot3.features: Being expanded — the old Postal Road was permanently closed for the Lot 3 expansion. Lost car locate, tire inflate, battery jump.

parkAndWalkLot2.name: BDL Park & Walk Lot 2
parkAndWalkLot2.rate: $10/day (4-24 hrs); $60/week (6-7 days); $5 first hour up to $8 at 3-4 hrs
parkAndWalkLot2.location: Across from Terminal B (International Arrivals Building)
parkAndWalkLot2.connection: No shuttle — short walk to Terminal A and Terminal B (crosswalk).
parkAndWalkLot2.features: Credit card only. Best lot for meeting Terminal B international arrivals.

expressLot1.name: BDL Express Lot 1
expressLot1.rate: $12/day (5-24 hrs); $72/week (6-7 days); $5 first hour up to $9 at 4-5 hrs
expressLot1.connection: Dedicated free shuttle to Terminal A on a continuous loop, 24/7; also a short walk to Terminal A and Terminal B.
expressLot1.features: Lost car locate, tire inflate, battery jump.

garage.name: BDL Garage
garage.rate: $30/day (4-24 hrs); $135/week (5-7 days); $4 first 30 min, $6 to 1 hr, then +$2 per 30 min to $18 at 3.5-4 hrs
garage.serves: Terminal A (closest parking to all airlines)
garage.features: Covered. Blended short- and long-term rate. Height limit 6'8" except ground floor 9'6". Lost car locate, tire inflate, battery jump.

lot5B.name: BDL Lot 5B (overflow)
lot5B.location: Light Lane, just north of the Cell Phone Lot
lot5B.note: Overflow lot open only when needed. Pay the cashier on entry; credit/debit card only. Overflow Lots 5A and 5D also appear on the parking map.

cellPhoneLot.name: Cell Phone Waiting Lot
cellPhoneLot.location: Light Lane, under 3 minutes' drive from Terminal A
cellPhoneLot.rules: No waiting at the curb or the arrivals pick-up area; wait here until your passenger calls.

locations: Cell Phone Waiting Lot (2 charging stations)
evCharging.note: No EV chargers are listed for the Garage or economy lots on the official parking site.

parkingAdvantageProgram.name: sPARK Rewards (Frequent Parker Program)
parkingAdvantageProgram.earning: 1 point per $1 spent (after tax) in any BDL lot or garage; one-time $30 automated pass; points do not expire, no blackout dates; accounts with no activity for 18 months are closed
parkingAdvantageProgram.redemption: 1 free day: Garage 300 pts, Lot 1 120, Lot 2 100, Lot 3 80, Lot 4 70. 1 free week: Garage 1,350, Lot 1 720, Lot 2 600, Lot 3 480, Lot 4 420 (as of Oct 1, 2025). Redemption does not reserve a space.
parkingAdvantageProgram.note: Questions: (877) 735-9280, Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM ET, info@parkbradley.com.

onAirportParking.reservations: None — the airport says no reservation is needed: arrive and park. Lot status (Available / Full) shows on parkbradleyairport.com.
onAirportParking.accessibleParking: Not detailed on parkbradleyairport.com — call Parking (860) 627-3555 (24/7).
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: Lot 2 is credit card only; Lot 5B is credit/debit only (pay cashier on entry). sPARK Rewards automated passes charge a card on file.
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Garage and Lot 2 → walk to Terminal A. Lots 1, 3, 4 → free 24/7 shuttle (airport FAQ: every ten minutes).

parkingLots.name: Econo Lodge Inn & Suites
parkingLots.parkingType: Limited valet (hotel lot — front desk parks your car)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Complimentary shuttle every 30 minutes, leaving at :15 and :45 past the hour. For a ride to the terminal between 3:15 AM and 5:15 AM you must call the hotel at least 24 hours ahead — seats are limited and not guaranteed. Leave your keys with the front desk and keep the claim check. On return, call (860) 623-2533 after collecting luggage and board the van marked Econo Lodge at the lower-level arrivals curb for hotel shuttles.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel park-and-fly lot minutes from Bradley with a free shuttle, no room reservation needed and no extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks or large SUVs. Limited valet: front desk staff park your car and return your keys against a claim check.
parkingLots.address: 34 Old County Rd, Windsor Locks, CT 06096
parkingLots.notes: Lowest sellable rate at BDL on 2026-10-16 ($52.90 grand total for a 7-night Nov 2-9 stay, 8 billed days; same on Nov 9-16 and 16-23). No box trucks, RVs or commercial vehicles. Early flights: 3:15-5:15 AM rides need a call 24 hours ahead. Overstays are settled at the front desk before you get your keys.

parkingLots.name: Motel 6 Windsor Locks
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Complimentary shuttle 24/7, every 30-45 minutes. On arrival, fill in the parking registration form at the front desk and show your online reservation confirmation before parking. Shuttle has limited accessibility equipment — call ahead if you need special transport. On return, call 860-370-5350 after collecting luggage; staff will tell you the pickup spot. Sign the checkout form at the desk before leaving.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel lot about 1.2-1.3 mi from Bradley with well-lit exterior parking under 24/7 CCTV, designated accessible spaces, and a 24/7 airport shuttle. Free lobby coffee 5-9 AM for registered guests.
parkingLots.notes: $53.00 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. Only Triply BDL lot with a 24/7 shuttle and no advance-call window. If your return is delayed, call the hotel — unannounced late pickups can mean extra fees or towing.

parkingLots.name: Days Inn Windsor Locks Bradley
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Every 30 minutes 3:25 AM-9:25 AM; on demand 9:25 AM-3:20 AM. Register your vehicle at the front desk for a dashboard tag. Outside shuttle hours, guests must arrange their own Uber, Lyft or taxi. On return, call (860) 623-9417 after collecting luggage.
parkingLots.overview: Days Inn by Wyndham Windsor Locks Bradley Airport, about a 3-minute drive from BDL, with free shuttle on every reservation, Wi-Fi and restrooms for parkers, and staff on site 24 hours.
parkingLots.address: 185 Ella Grasso Turnpike, Windsor Locks, CT 06096
parkingLots.notes: $78.82 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. Closest Triply BDL lot. Scheduled shuttles from 3:25 AM suit 5-6 AM departures.

parkingLots.name: The Parking Spot (BDL)
parkingLots.parkingType: Covered valet and uncovered self-park (off-airport operator)
parkingLots.notes: Major off-airport operator near BDL. Not sold on Triply — comparison only; never use in a CTA.

parkingLots.name: LAZ Fly Airport Parking
parkingLots.address: Ella Grasso Turnpike (Route 75), Windsor Locks, CT 06096
parkingLots.notes: Off-airport operator with lots on Route 75. Not sold on Triply — comparison only; never use in a CTA.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Express Lot 1, Economy Lot 3 and Economy Lot 4 run free shuttles to Terminal A on a continuous 24/7 loop (airport FAQ: every ten minutes); Lot 2 and the Garage are walk-to. Off-site: Triply's three BDL lots are 1.1-1.3 mi away. Motel 6 runs 24/7 every 30-45 min; Days Inn every 30 min from 3:25 AM, on demand otherwise (none 3:20-3:25 AM); Econo Lodge every 30 min but 3:15-5:15 AM rides must be booked 24 hours ahead. Call the lot after collecting bags.
distanceFromCity: About 15-20 minutes' drive north of downtown Hartford via I-91 (airport figures); about 15 minutes south of Springfield, MA.

keyDistances.toDowntownHartford: 15-20 minutes by car; ~30 minutes on the CTtransit 30-Bradley Flyer
keyDistances.toTriplyLots: 1.1-1.3 mi (Days Inn, Econo Lodge Inn & Suites, Motel 6 — all in Windsor Locks)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: All three Triply BDL lots are within ~1.3 miles and bookable in advance — BDL's own lots take no reservations and can fill at peak times.

construction2026.status: Terminal A improvement program (more than $250 million; current projects 2025-2030): new 80,000 sq ft inline baggage screening facility, new exit lanes on both sides of the terminal, expanded TSA checkpoint, and a new three-gate concourse. Economy Lot 3 is being expanded.
projects: Inline baggage screening facility and new exit lanes (vertical circulation)
New three-gate concourse in Terminal A (Wikipedia reports it is used by Breeze)
Economy Lot 3 expansion — old Postal Road permanently closed; post office now reached via a new road off Light Lane
Taxiway T extension (final environmental assessment published)
construction2026.travelImpact: The airport says the Postal Road change affects post office access only, not terminal traffic. It also warns parking can be at or near capacity at times — allow extra time or use alternative parking on Schoephoester Road or Routes 20 and 75.

securityAndScreening.checkpoints: Main TSA checkpoint in the departures-level lobby (general lanes, CLEAR). Second checkpoint between the United ticket counter and the hallway to the Sheraton — TSA PreCheck (and PreCheck + CLEAR) only.

tsaPreCheck.note: PreCheck lanes moved to the second checkpoint, between the United ticket counter and the Sheraton hallway.

globalEntry.note: BDL has a Global Entry Enrollment Center. Cancun and charter arrivals clear CBP in Terminal B; Aer Lingus (Dublin) passengers pre-clear and arrive at Terminal A.

standardWaitTimes.tips: Most airline ticket counters open 4-5 AM; terminals are open 24 hours. Flippit mail-back box near the main checkpoint ($29) for prohibited items.

arrivalRecommendation.domestic: At least 90 minutes before departure (airport guidance)
arrivalRecommendation.holidays: Add time at peak periods — parking may be near capacity

terminalA.name: Escape Lounge
terminalA.access: $45 pre-book / $60 walk-up; Priority Pass (pre-book); free for Amex Platinum and Delta SkyMiles Reserve cardholders on Delta flights

lounges.other: Escape Lounge is the only lounge at BDL. Pets are not allowed in the lounge.

wifi.coverage: All terminals; free charging stations throughout

cellPhoneLot.location: Cell Phone Waiting Lot, Light Lane

evCharging.note: No EV chargers are listed for the Garage or economy lots on the official parking site. None of the Triply BDL lots list EV charging.

locations: Outdoor relief area, lower level next to Door #1
Indoor relief area in Terminal A near the iStore
petFacilities.note: Pets must stay in kennels in the terminal (service animals excepted); no pets in the Escape Lounge.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Spring break (heavy Florida demand on Breeze, JetBlue, Southwest), summer, Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Winter getaways to Florida and the Caribbean drive January-March demand.

arrivalRecommendation.domestic: At least 90 minutes before departure (airport guidance)
arrivalRecommendation.holidays: Allow extra time to park and clear security during peaks

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid continental: cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers in the Connecticut River valley.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Snow, ice and nor'easters (December-March); summer thunderstorms; fog.
weatherPatterns.winterNote: Allow extra time for snow on I-91 and for clearing your car. BDL lots offer battery jumps, tire inflation and lost-car locate. Econo Lodge's limited valet means staff move your car; Motel 6 and Days Inn are outdoor self-park.
weatherPatterns.note: Bring a scraper if you park at an outdoor lot. Only the BDL Garage (and part of the Ground Transportation Center parking) is covered.

parkSleepFly.description: Hotel + parking + shuttle combos in Windsor Locks. Triply sells parking-only at the three hotels below; room packages are booked with the hotel. The Sheraton Bradley is attached to Terminal A.
parkSleepFly.priceRange: Parking-only via Triply from ~$5.49/day (2026-10-16 quote); room package pricing — ask the hotel

popularHotels.name: Econo Lodge Inn & Suites
popularHotels.shuttleHours: Every 30 min; 3:15-5:15 AM by advance call
popularHotels.highlight: Cheapest Triply rate at BDL; limited valet; no oversize charge for vans, pickups and large SUVs.

popularHotels.name: Days Inn Windsor Locks Bradley
popularHotels.shuttleHours: Every 30 min 3:25-9:25 AM; on demand to 3:20 AM

savingsComparison.scenario: 7-night trip (Nov 2-9, 2026, 10 AM drop-off / 2 PM pickup — Triply bills 8 days), quoted 2026-10-16. On-airport figures = 8 x the official daily rate. BDL also publishes weekly rates for 6-7 day stays (Garage 5-7) — Lot 4 $42, Lot 3 $48, Lot 2 $60, Lot 1 $72, Garage $135 — and does not publish how an 8th day is billed, so a weekly-plus-one-day bill could be lower (e.g. Lot 4 ~$49).

econoLodgeInnSuites.savingsVsEconomyLot4: ~$3 saved (but roughly even or slightly dearer if Lot 4's weekly rate applies)
econoLodgeInnSuites.caveat: Limited valet; 3:15-5:15 AM shuttle rides need a call 24 hours ahead

motel6WindsorLocks.savingsVsEconomyLot4: ~$3 saved (roughly even if Lot 4's weekly rate applies)
motel6WindsorLocks.caveat: Self-park; register and sign out at the front desk

savingsComparison.keyDifference: BDL's own Economy Lot 4 ($7/day, $42/week) is one of the cheapest official airport lots in the U.S., so never claim Triply 'saves big' versus Lot 4 — Econo Lodge and Motel 6 only roughly match it, and Days Inn costs more. Anchor savings against the $30 Garage and $12 Express Lot 1, and sell Triply on a reserved spot (BDL takes no reservations and lots can fill), Econo Lodge's valet and Motel 6's 24/7 shuttle.

uniqueFeatures.eugeneBradley: Named for 2nd Lt. Eugene M. Bradley, a 24-year-old pilot killed in a 1941 training flight at the field.
uniqueFeatures.attachedHotel: The Sheraton Hartford Hotel at Bradley is attached to Terminal A — walk from gate to front desk.
uniqueFeatures.concorde: One of three U.S. diversion airports for the Concorde; a British Airways Concorde diverted here in February 2003.
uniqueFeatures.newEnglandAirMuseum: The New England Air Museum sits next to the airport.
uniqueFeatures.airGuard: Home of the Connecticut Air National Guard's 103rd Airlift Wing (C-130s) and Connecticut Army National Guard aviation units.
uniqueFeatures.breezeBase: Breeze Airways has operated a base at BDL since 2022.
uniqueFeatures.groundTransportationCenter: $210 million Ground Transportation Center (2022) consolidated all rental cars and added 830 public parking spaces, more than half covered.

emergencyContacts.lostAndFound: Connecticut State Police (items found on airport grounds): (860) 292-7400; TSA checkpoint items via tsa.gov; on-board items via your airline
emergencyContacts.emergency: 911 — state you are at Bradley International Airport, Windsor Locks
